extra_trees.class_weight: balanced independently per label; no joint weight multiplication

metadata.fit_row_sampling: Seeded uniform training-only sampling without replacement
metadata.redundancy_method: Pairwise-complete Pearson on fit rows; NaNs not imputed
metadata.imputation: Training fit-row medians for MI and trees only; sampled-all-missing columns use 0
metadata.ranking_method: Equal-weight Pearson/Spearman/MI/ExtraTrees normalized tied ranks per label; equal-label mean, preceded by one round of per-label best unused features
metadata.subset_semantics: 8/16/32/64 are prefixes of correlation-pruned ranking; all includes every eligible feature; proxy_ablated is all minus position/heading/fuel-level/cumulative/time proxies
metadata.instrumentation_note: Preliminary feature ranking is not an inferred minimum instrumentation set. Audit required sensors/context/calibration/history before deployment.
metadata.permutation_importance: Not computed: caller must use truck-independent validation; API has no truck IDs
metadata.shap: Skipped: optional SHAP dependency not required; association and tree impurity evidence only
metadata.feature_engineering: Existing exported observation-derived columns only; source data not modified
